[Cyclone monitoring] NHC forecast issued Jul. 2, 2pm (Beryl)
This is an automated message produced by the OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data.

Dear colleagues,

NHC has issued their cyclone forecasts for Jul. 2, 2pm (NY time). There is 1 active storm: Beryl.

This email consolidates exposure estimates from OCHA CHD. Estimates from ADAM and GDACS were not accessed for this email. Full admin-1 figures are in the attached spreadsheet; example alerts with the full charts and the methodology are online.

Best regards,
OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data

Probabilistic forecast

Reading the charts below: everything sits on one axis, population exposed. Dots are the current estimates by source (labelled beneath the axis) · vertical ticks are past storms since 2002, the most similar ones in bold · the shaded curve, where shown, is the exposure distribution of every storm to affect the country since 2002 — the same storms at every wind speed, so at 50 and 64 kt it concentrates near zero (most storms never bring those winds there) and a storm out in the tail is genuinely rare · the scale never runs past the country's total population · a dashed line marks exposure already observed.

Curaçao (Neth.)

This is the last update for Beryl in Curaçao (Neth.). The storm is no longer forecast to expose anyone in Curaçao (Neth.), and no exposure has been reported there — earlier alerts were based on forecast tracks that have since moved away. Figures below and in the attached data are zero and will not change, unless the track of the storm changes significantly and returns towards Curaçao (Neth.) again. In this case another update will be issued for Beryl in Curaçao (Neth.).
